name: No invented professional claims
test: No personal project, metrics, awards, role, certification, employer approval or timeline becomes public without approved public proof.

name: Assets provenance
test: Only owner-supplied portrait may represent owner; every derivative provenance points at original SHA.

name: Zero fake controls
test: 40 screens have real backend/local destinations or explicit disabled/unavailable states.

name: AI UI Configuration
test: Add/test/disable/switch selfhosted and managed providers without editing source code.

name: Secrets
test: No API keys, tokens or sensitive GitHub data in frontend, mobile packages, Git commits, errors or logs.

name: Queue limits
test: AI tasks one-at-a-time per provider by default, checkpointed, durable retries and idempotency.

name: Offline mobile
test: Offline runbooks open without internet, clearly show version and stale state.

name: Publish workflow
test: Evidence + citations + technical checks; low-risk automatic, high-risk approval queue; scheduled unpublish.

name: GitHub
test: Repository allowlist and public visibility checks; verify exact source timestamp; show no invented numbers.

name: Worker overlap
test: Exactly one active task owner and disjoint path ownership; change/reassignment documented.

name: PR exact-head CI
test: Required gate at latest PR SHA green with changed-scope checks and tests.

name: Release provenance
test: Tag+artifact+deploy evidence, staging smoke, rollback; never claim release without success.

name: Accessibility
test: Arabic RTL, English LTR, keyboard, contrast, accessible labels, tap targets, reduced motion.

name: Responsive
test: Desktop/tablet/mobile for public/admin, Android/iOS device matrices for app.

name: SEO
test: Article canonical, sitemap, structured data where validated, robots, language alternates, redirects.

name: Privacy/consent
test: Consent for notifications, unsubscribe, account removal, transparent retention rules.

name: Data migration
test: Old SQL imported content-only through sanitize whitelist; reject user/password/subscribers/unsafe uploads.

name: Image generation
test: AI images via selected UI provider; rights/provenance; no fake headshots or diagrams claimed real.

name: Cost protection
test: Admin quotas, budget caps, provider circuit breaker, never retry endlessly.

name: Owner only tests final stage
test: During ordinary development defer owner questions; blockers isolated with defaults documented, report at staging handoff.
